title: Schisandrin B alleviates testicular inflammation and Sertoli cell apoptosis via AR-JNK pathway.
authors: Zhang, Bo-Yang; Yang, Rui; Zhu, Wen-Qian; Zhu, Chun-Ling; Chen, Lan-Xin; Zhao, Yan-Sen; Zhang, Yan; Wang, Yue-Qi; Jiang, Dao-Zhen; Tang, Bo; Zhang, Xue-Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分SchB通过AR-JNK通路缓解睾丸炎症，仅涉及分子对接预测AR与配体结合，未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Bacterial testicular inflammation is one of the important causes of male infertility. Using plant-derived compounds to overcome the side effects of antibiotics is an alternative treatment strategy for many diseases. Schizandrin B (SchB) is a bioactive compound of herbal medicine Schisandra chinensis which has multiple pharmacological effects. However its effect and the mechanism against testicular inflammation are unknown. Here we tackled these questions using models of lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced mice and -Sertoli cells (SCs). Histologically, SchB ameliorated the LPS-induced damages of the seminiferous epithelium and blood-testicular barrier, and reduced the production of pro-inflammatory mediators in mouse testes. Furthermore, SchB decreased the levels of pro-inflammatory mediators and inhibited the nuclear factor kB (NF-kappaB) and MAPK (especially JNK) signaling pathway phosphorylation in LPS-induced mSCs. The bioinformatics analysis based on receptor prediction and the molecular docking was further conducted. We targeted androgen receptor (AR) and illustrated that AR might bind with SchB in its function. Further experiments indicate that the AR expression was upregulated by LPS stimulation, while SchB treatment reversed this phenomenon; similarly, the expression of the JNK-related proteins and apoptotic-related protein were also reversed after AR activator treatment. Together, SchB mitigates LPS-induced inflammation and apoptosis by inhibiting the AR-JNK pathway.
abstract_zh: 细菌性睾丸炎症是男性不育的重要原因之一。利用植物来源化合物克服抗生素的副作用，是治疗多种疾病的替代策略。五味子乙素（Schizandrin B, SchB）是中药五味子的一种生物活性化合物，具有多种药理作用。然而，其对睾丸炎症的作用及其机制尚不清楚。在此，我们利用脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）诱导的小鼠和塞尔托利细胞（Sertoli cells, SCs）模型来探讨这些问题。在组织学上，SchB改善了LPS诱导的生精上皮和血-睾屏障损伤，并减少了小鼠睾丸中促炎介质的产生。此外，SchB降低了LPS诱导的小鼠SCs中促炎介质的水平，并抑制了核因子kB（nuclear factor kB, NF-kappaB）和MAPK（尤其是JNK）信号通路磷酸化。进一步进行了基于受体预测和分子对接的生物信息学分析。我们靶向雄激素受体（androgen receptor, AR），并阐明AR可能与其功能中的SchB结合。进一步实验表明，LPS刺激上调了AR表达，而SchB处理逆转了这一现象；同样，在AR激活剂处理后，JNK相关蛋白和凋亡相关蛋白的表达也发生了逆转。总之，SchB通过抑制AR-JNK通路减轻LPS诱导的炎症和凋亡。
